summary: Iteration 4 (age-gated signup + Stripe payments + voice-video) fully tested. Backend: 43/43 pytest passed (35 regression from test_linkchat_backend.py + test_new_features.py after updating _signup helpers with birth_date='2000-01-01'; 8 new in test_iter4_payments_age.py covering missing birth_date→422, under-13→400 with '13+' message, 13+ succeeds, GET /api/plans contains all 4 lookup_keys, POST /api/payments/checkout unauthenticated→401, invalid lookup_key→400, valid lookup_key returns checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com and session_id, GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns {session_id,status,payment_status in [pending|unpaid|...]}). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): /auth signup — toggle-auth-mode works, signup-birthdate-input present, filling under-13 (2020-01-01) triggers 400 and '13+' error toast, filling 13+ (2000-01-01) signs up and lands on /app. Plans flow: logged-out plan-cta-pro click navigates to /auth ✓; logged-in alice@test.com/pass1234 → plan-cta-pro triggers POST /api/payments/checkout and the live Stripe checkout page (checkout.stripe.com sandbox showing 'Subscribe to Linkas Pro US$3.78/month') loads ✓. Billing toggle: billing-month/billing-year both present, clicking Anual shows Pro R$190/ano and Comunidade R$490/ano. Age gate bypass via add_init_script setting localStorage lc_age_verified=1 works. VoiceRoom source has voice-join-button and voice-video-button data-testids as specified (video button rendered conditionally after join — cannot assert without real media). Regression login alice@test.com worked (reached /app).
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe webhook secret: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is referenced; ensure it is set in backend/.env for production and not left empty, otherwise webhook signature verification will fail silently.
server.py now ~785 lines — approaching the single-file smell; consider splitting payments/stripe routes into /app/backend/routes/payments.py.

stripe.Price.list is called synchronously inside an async def route (create_checkout + payment_status) — this blocks the event loop. Consider wrapping in run_in_executor or using Stripe's async client.
Previous comments carry over: @app.on_event deprecated (use lifespan handlers), GET /api/files/{path} is unauthenticated, voice_signals/typing collections lack TTL indexes.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_payments_age.py (new — 8 tests for age gate / plans / stripe checkout / payment status)
test_credentials: alice@test.com / pass1234 (existing, pre-dates age gate — login still works). New signups require birth_date e.g. '2000-01-01'. Bypass age overlay with Playwright add_init_script setting localStorage.setItem('lc_age_verified','1').
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates fresh TEST_<uuid>@test.com accounts via POST /api/auth/signup with birth_date 2000-01-01. One new 'Kid Test' and one 'Payer' user were created during frontend/backend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: /api/auth/signup now REQUIRES birth_date; both backend test helpers were updated to send birth_date='2000-01-01'. For frontend age-gate bypass use page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('lc_age_verified','1')") BEFORE page.goto — setting it after goto doesn't work because AgeGate reads localStorage on mount. Stripe checkout: POST /api/payments/checkout {lookup_key:'pro_monthly', origin_url:...} returns real https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL (sandbox 'infra-boost-creative'). Payment status returns pending until a real card is used — do NOT attempt automation of the Stripe card form. VoiceRoom's voice-video-button is only mounted after a successful voice/join + getUserMedia camera grab, which cannot be automated in headless Playwright without --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream flags.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All iteration-4 features (age gate on signup, Stripe checkout, plans mapping, payment status, voice UI testids) pass. Only test harness update required was adding birth_date to existing _signup helpers; previously those were silently relying on missing-field behavior that is now 422.
